[EN] spoke to a goblin and baraka about the archdevans' activities in Ex Prima.
[ES] habló con un goblin y un baraka sobre las actividades de los archdevas en Ex Prima.

[EN] We must gather information about the archdevas' activities, but the Seekers will not be all that useful. Let us seek another.

There is a goblin, Jagreg, who can be found east of Baaldaz Post. Ask him if he has seen any archdevas around."I'll talk to him."
[ES] Debemos recopilar información sobre las actividades de los archdevas, pero los Seekers no serán de mucha utilidad. Busquemos a otro.

Hay un goblin, Jagreg, que se encuentra al este de Baaldaz Post. Pregúntale si ha visto algún archdeva por la zona."I'll talk to him."

[EN] Stay away from Jagreg's moneytrees, !

Jagreg saw them first! That makes them Jagreg's pecunia fruit!"Hmm. I can get them for you...for a price."
[ES] ¡Aléjate de los árboles de dinero de Jagreg, !

¡Jagreg los vio primero! ¡Eso los convierte en la fruta pecunia de Jagreg!"Hmm. I can get them for you...for a price."

[EN] ...trade? Alright.

Jagreg agrees! Get them now!"Okay, wait here."
[ES] ...¿comercio? De acuerdo.

¡Jagreg acepta! ¡Consíguelos ahora!"Okay, wait here."

[EN] Hah! Jagreg is rich!

Good work, . Now, what you want to know?"What are the archdevas doing?"
[ES] ¡Ja! ¡Jagreg es rico!

Buen trabajo, . Ahora, ¿qué quieres saber?"What are the archdevas doing?"

[EN] Archdevas? dies soon, Jagreg thinks.

Archdevas digging up the past. Don't know why."Do you know where?"
[ES] ¿Archdevas? morirá pronto, piensa Jagreg.

Los archdevas desentierran el pasado. No sé por qué."Do you know where?"

[EN] Kamun.

Kamun knows where. Kamun watches archdevas. Studies. Kamun dies soon too, Jagreg thinks.

Ask Kamun."Enjoy your pecunia fruit, Jagreg."
[ES] Kamun.

Kamun sabe dónde. Kamun observa a los archdevas. Estudia. Kamun morirá pronto también, piensa Jagreg.

Pregúntale a Kamun."Enjoy your pecunia fruit, Jagreg."

[EN] The archdevas have numerous camps in this region. Any one of them could prove the locus of their Storm Barrier apparatus."Which one is most likely?"
[ES] Los archdevas tienen numerosos campamentos en esta región. Cualquiera de ellos podría resultar ser el epicentro de su aparato de la Storm Barrier."Which one is most likely?"

[EN] An excellent question!

The best way to find an accurate answer is to interrogate an archdeva or two—but they are notoriously dishonest. I have only been able to obtain accurate intelligence by judicious application of truth needles."Any chance you have a spare?"
[ES] ¡Una excelente pregunta!

La mejor manera de encontrar una respuesta precisa es interrogar a uno o dos archdevas, pero son notoriamente deshonestos. Solo he podido obtener información precisa mediante la aplicación juiciosa de agujas de la verdad."Any chance you have a spare?"

[EN] Alas, my supply is depleted. I was just now preparing to mount an expedition to collect more components—but if you would undertake that task, I would be willing to make one for you.

Simply acquire some glittering scales from the nearby chupathingies."All right."
[ES] Ay, mis suministros están agotados. Justo me estaba preparando para montar una expedición para recolectar más componentes, pero si tú emprendes esa tarea, estaría dispuesto a hacer una para ti.

Simplemente consigue algunas escamas brillantes de las chupathingies cercanas."All right."

[EN] Were you successful in obtaining the glittering scales?"All in a day's work."
[ES] ¿Tuviste éxito al conseguir las escamas brillantes?"All in a day's work."

[EN] Still searching for glittering scales? Ascertaining the truth requires it.
[ES] ¿Sigues buscando escamas brillantes? Descubrir la verdad lo requiere.

[EN] You have done well. Now just give me a moment...and...there!

May this truth needle serve you well."Thank you, Kamun."
[ES] Lo has hecho bien. Ahora solo dame un momento... ¡y... listo!

Que esta aguja de la verdad te sirva bien."Thank you, Kamun."
